verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs say users can apply suggested changes directly to the PR with a single click, with no copy-paste (docs-23). Pricing lists '1-click fixes' (docs-61), and inline comments carry suggested fixes, including for CI failures (docs-44, docs-26). Change Stack also supports applying suggestions (docs-80), and a community thread independently notes it offers directly committable fixes (comm-8). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the suggested-diff format and how it renders on each Git platform (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps), plus hands-on corroboration of applying a suggestion with one click.
